players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ (10-Q): on July 31, 2026 completed the acquisition of SkyWater Technology, a U.S.-based semiconductor foundry; IonQ says the acquisition will advance its quantum computing roadmap by giving it access to SkyWater's U.S.-based foundry capabilities, advanced packaging expertise and Technology as a Service platform.
